read: 2026-10-11, by eye from the cached layout image
comment: Perfboard layout of a Belton-brick reverb with a TL074 and a 78L05; the image also shows the underside, a colour wiring diagram and an etched PCB of the same circuit. Legend gives a 'wetter mod': the 10K marked * becomes 22K, the 39K becomes 82K and the 56K becomes 47K.
uncertain: Regulator beside the BTDR2: the board view shows only pins I G O; '78L05' is read from the wiring diagram, where it overlaps a trace
rows: one is marked 10K* (22K for the wetter mod)
